title: Commerce adds export controls on advanced computing chips and semiconductor manufacturing items destined for China
abstract: The Bureau of Industry and Security imposes license requirements on exports of advanced integrated circuits, computers containing them, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China.

title: Proclamation adjusting imports of steel and aluminum into the United States
abstract: Raises Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum imports and removes country exemptions.

title: Additional Section 301 tariffs on products of China
abstract: The U.S. Trade Representative raises duties on a list of consumer and industrial goods imported from China.

title: Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: selected drugs and negotiated prices
abstract: CMS publishes negotiated maximum fair prices for selected Part D drugs under the Inflation Reduction Act.

title: Blocking property and prohibiting new investment in the Russian Federation
abstract: OFAC expands sanctions on Russia, prohibiting new investment and certain services by U.S. persons.

title: Regulatory capital rule: large banking organizations (Basel III endgame)
abstract: The Federal Reserve, FDIC and OCC propose revised capital requirements for banks with $100 billion or more in assets.

title: Multi-pollutant emissions standards for light-duty and medium-duty vehicles
abstract: EPA sets stricter greenhouse gas and pollutant standards for model year 2027 and later vehicles.

title: Credit card penalty fees (Regulation Z)
abstract: The CFPB lowers the safe-harbor amount large card issuers may charge for late payments.

title: Debit card interchange fees and routing (Regulation II)
abstract: The Federal Reserve proposes to lower the cap on interchange fees for debit transactions at large issuers.

title: Safeguarding and securing the open internet (net neutrality)
abstract: The FCC reclassifies broadband internet access service as a telecommunications service under Title II.

title: Section 232 investigation of imports of pharmaceuticals and pharmaceutical ingredients
abstract: Commerce opens a national security investigation that may lead to tariffs on imported drugs and ingredients.

title: Medicare Advantage capitation rates and Part C and Part D payment policies
abstract: CMS announces payment rates and risk adjustment changes for Medicare Advantage plans.

title: National outer continental shelf oil and gas leasing program
abstract: The Interior Department sets the schedule of offshore oil and gas lease sales.

title: Imposing duties to address the flow of illicit drugs across the northern and southern borders
abstract: Executive order imposing tariffs on imports from Canada and Mexico under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.

title: Restriction on entry of certain nonimmigrant workers (H-1B)
abstract: Proclamation adding a fee and new conditions for H-1B specialty occupation visa petitions.

title: Federal Acquisition Regulation: cybersecurity requirements for defense contractors (CMMC)
abstract: The Department of Defense requires contractors to meet cybersecurity maturity certification levels to win contracts.

title: Global minimum tax: treatment of foreign taxes under Pillar Two
abstract: Treasury and IRS guidance on how the 15 percent global minimum tax interacts with U.S. foreign tax credits.
